elaboration.description: Satellite provides additional detail or exemplification of the Nucleus

contrast.description: Two or more nuclei are compared along salient dimensions with opposing values

cause.description: Satellite presents the causal situation that produced the Nucleus event

condition.description: Satellite specifies a hypothetical situation upon which the Nucleus realization depends

concession.description: Speaker acknowledges a potential incompatibility between Satellite and Nucleus, but affirms Nucleus

background.description: Satellite provides context necessary for the hearer to comprehend the Nucleus

sequence.description: Nuclei occur in chronological or procedural temporal succession
